plan.title: Closed RFQ Edit Evaluation Time Cancel

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the RFQ scenario.
Apply the required restriction on post-expiry surrogate bids.
Apply the required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Apply the required evaluation-reopen permission configuration.
Open the RFQ Settings action and leave the Edit Evaluation Time dialog open.
Confirm the expected evaluation-time dialog opened.
Cancel the evaluation-time edit without saving changes.
Verify that Cancel closed the dialog.
Verify the Responses screen remains rendered without errors or corrupted values.
Verify the existing bid vendor is still represented after cancellation.
Verify the existing bid price remains unchanged after cancellation.
